packageRules.description: Automerge digest, patch and pin updates (python base image digest, PyPI pins) once the Test workflow passes; the merge then cuts a patch release (auto-release.yml). platformAutomerge is off: GitHub auto-merge is disabled and main has no required checks, so GitHub could merge before CI finishes. Minor and major updates wait for a person

Docker Hub serves tag timestamps to anonymous clients only for the first 1000 tags. library/python has 4000+, so Renovate falls back to the registry tag list, which has no timestamps, and under the default timestamp-required every python digest update would wait forever. Apply the 3-day age only when a timestamp exists (renovatebot/renovate#46925)

One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps the SHA + '# vX.Y.Z' comment current). Never automerge: new action code runs with packages: write, so a person reviews every bump. Placed after the automerge rule so this automerge: false wins
